working_title: Parameter definitions and cross-paper comparability requirements
scientific_purpose: Prevent false comparison by defining required components, valid use, and common failure modes.
comparison_axis: parameter definition completeness and physical context
included_parameter_groups: NPR; Mach; We; Re; Oh; loading duration; breakup time; ΔSOI; L_E/L_D
included_condition_groups: pressure roles/types; frames; event definitions; phase/state; scale definition
included_paper_scope: definition-ready exemplars only; not a paper inventory
expected_columns: parameter; required components; compatible use; constraints; common failure mode
risk_or_limitation: Definitions may remain NR/NV; do not complete them by inference.

scientific_purpose: Compare only condition-compatible jet/shock observables and separate transient stages.
included_parameter_groups: p_inj(t); contextual NPR; x_MD/D; shock-cell metrics; gas species; nozzle geometry
definition_matching_required: yes—pressure role/type, D basis, feature, and stage
quantitative_or_qualitative: mixed; quantitative subset plus condition table
expected_columns: paper/case; pressure definition; gas/nozzle/ambient; transient state; comparable observables
risk_or_limitation: Data beyond Mach-disk position are sparse and heterogeneous.

working_title: Compressible droplet-response regimes under definition-complete loading
scientific_purpose: Compare response mechanisms and regimes without imposing universal Weber thresholds.
comparison_axis: loading/material state → deformation and breakup response
included_parameter_groups: M_s/M_rel; We; Re; Oh; d0; loading duration; liquid; breakup event
included_condition_groups: inert/reacting; planar/divergent; isolated droplet; thermal state
definition_matching_required: yes—Mach frame, We components, event and liquid state
expected_columns: paper/case; loading definition; material/size; duration; observed response; transfer limit
risk_or_limitation: C004 missing; sparse fully matched definitions.
notes: Regime labels retained with source taxonomy.

working_title: Collective effects and canonical-to-HPDI transfer limits
scientific_purpose: Contrast isolated, ordered, cloud, and dense-spray states and identify required corrections.
included_parameter_groups: S/D; arrangement; volume fraction; size distribution; attenuation metrics
included_condition_groups: single; tandem; parallel; dilute cloud; dense polydisperse reacting spray
included_paper_scope: canonical collective evidence and transfer audit
definition_matching_required: yes—descriptor type and arrangement cannot be merged
quantitative_or_qualitative: qualitative comparison with limited quantitative cells
expected_columns: configuration; direct mechanism; key descriptors; supported evidence; transfer limitation
risk_or_limitation: No dense HPDI validation; do not infer a universal spacing law.

working_title: Breakup, fragment-state, and phase-change coupling boundaries
scientific_purpose: Compare coupling direction and product-state requirements across matched thermal and loading conditions.
comparison_axis: fragment/thermal state → transport and phase-change direction
included_parameter_groups: fragment distributions; d0; gas T; volatility; Stefan number; density ratio; evaporation scale
included_condition_groups: small/large droplet; vapor-layer suppression; thermal promotion; observation interval
included_paper_scope: selected direct and model-conditioned C/D evidence
definition_matching_required: yes—size, liquid, thermal state, gas history, statistic and interval
quantitative_or_qualitative: qualitative boundary table with reported condition ranges
expected_columns: condition; dominant mechanism; response direction; evidence type; boundary; limitation
notes: Do not force contradictory conditions into one trend.

working_title: HPDI timing, mixture, ignition, and combustion evidence
scientific_purpose: Organize direct application evidence by chronology, mixture/ignition outcome, and operating boundary.
comparison_axis: signed injection chronology and geometry → mixture/ignition/combustion response
included_parameter_groups: ΔSOI; dwell/overlap; injection duration; ignition delay; energy share; AHRR
included_condition_groups: fuel order; geometry; oxygen/T; load; engine/vessel/model
included_paper_scope: strongest direct A-library anchors plus selected boundary cases
definition_matching_required: yes—event definitions, sign, fuel order, and operating point
expected_columns: paper/case; chronology; geometry/ambient; mixture evidence; ignition; combustion; caution
risk_or_limitation: Do not attribute direct timing effects to shock-mediated atomization.
notes: Paper-conditioned claims may appear as bounded rows.

scientific_purpose: Separate transferable physical insight, analogue-only relations, and unvalidated HPDI mapping.
comparison_axis: strong-wave mechanism and characteristic scale versus application transfer

included_paper_scope: D/C strong-wave evidence and transfer audit

quantitative_or_qualitative: qualitative transfer matrix with within-domain quantitative entries

working_title: Knowledge gaps, unclosed pathways, and required evidence
scientific_purpose: Map every frozen KG to its first location, unclosed pathway, and concrete closure evidence.
comparison_axis: gap location → required evidence and research priority
included_parameter_groups: co-located shock/gas state; droplet/fragment populations; species fields; ignition/heat release; definitions
included_condition_groups: HPDI geometry and chronology; dense reacting spray; RDE analogue; source availability
included_paper_scope: evidence boundaries rather than literature inventory
definition_matching_required: yes—measurement and event definitions are part of each research need
expected_columns: KG; pathway/segment; known; missing; required diagnostic; priority; caution
risk_or_limitation: C004 is a source limitation and must not be ranked as a mechanism closure experiment.
